text: Western comics style, bold ink outlines, hatched shadows, hard red-tinted rim light glowing along the edges of her face, ferocious screaming rage, seen from a steep low angle, extreme close-up on the head only, tight framing, dutch angle, sharp perspective. female half-orc, head thrown back with a wild tangle of black hair across her face, thick furrowed eyebrows pressed low in fury, wide crimson eyes wide with screaming rage, mouth stretched open in a full-throated roar baring a single sharp lower tusk, a thick iron ring pierced through the nose bridge, ferociously screaming expression. white background, simple background.
